role: Data type definitions for the Co-Being Procedural Knowledge Graph and procedure execution engine.
detail: Defines pure data structures for the procedure execution pipeline: ExecutionRequest (input contract with procedure_id, operands, correlation_id, classification_confidence, max_call_depth, deadline/call_stack tracking) and ExecutionResult (output with result_node_id, result_value, strategy, confidence, execution_time_ms, contradiction_detected). OPERATIONS registry contains 21 deterministic primitive operations (arithmetic: add/subtract/multiply/divide/modulo/successor, comparison: gt/lt/eq, set operations: union/removal/count, string morphology: append/strip_suffix/ends_with/preceded_by_vowel/length, boolean: or/and/not). Node type constants: PROCEDURAL_TEMPLATE, PROCEDURE_STEP, WORKED_EXAMPLE, CONCEPT_PRIMITIVE, VALUE_NODE. Edge type constants: HAS_PROCEDURE_BODY, HAS_WORKED_EXAMPLE, DEPENDS_ON, HAS_OPERAND, INSTANCE_OF_CONCEPT, COMPUTES_TO, DOES_NOT_COMPUTE_TO, GENERATED_BY. Seven custom exception classes for execution errors (ProcedureNotFoundError, OperandTypeMismatchError, DivisionByZeroError, DependencyMissingError, ExecutionTimeoutError, RecursionDepthExceededError, CircularProcedureError). No I/O, graph access, or LLM calls—pure type definitions.
gotchas: divide and modulo operations return None on zero divisor (executor raises DivisionByZeroError on None result); set_union implemented as concatenation (not true set union); ExecutionRequest._deadline and _call_stack are private; circular imports avoided by typing contradiction_event as object; Phase 1.6 baseline with Phase 1.7 string/boolean operation additions
